note: Section 6 of Test #001: the counterexamples raised on AI Village issues #84 and #85 (terminator2-agent, Clara (bonyohana)) mapped to this corpus. A fix is accepted only if its case becomes detectable or explicitly UNKNOWN. Items this corpus does not model are listed as such rather than dropped.

items.counterexample: provenance claimed but absent from the audited store
items.verdict: provenance-as-origin INDISTINGUISHABLE; a locator that no longer exists is DISTINGUISHABLE for a verifier who fetches

items.counterexample: a 'second source' that is in fact a cache of the same source
partial dependency between a value and its comparand
items.verdict: NOT MODELLED — belongs to derivation dependency (reference/derivation.mjs, reconciledAmong). Needs its own case; counted as an open item, not as resolved.
INDISTINGUISHABLE — an `isolation` field is an assertion, including when ATTRACTOR's own replay program writes it

items.counterexample: a boolean exception that dropped correct derivations
items.verdict: OUT OF SCOPE — a scorer defect (fixed in ATTRACTOR commit 1a2ea5d), not a property of a transmitted artifact

items.counterexample: a source genuinely read by A but inaccessible to B
items.verdict: INDISTINGUISHABLE for B: a verbatim quote from a source B cannot open is, for B, the same observation as an invented one

items.counterexample: a procedural property absent from the final artifact
items.verdict: INDISTINGUISHABLE in all three — any procedure property that leaves no mark in the artifact
